propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut beati Petri Martyris tui fidem
congrua devotione sectemur; qui, pro ejusdem fidei dilatatione, martyrii
palmam meruit obtinere. Per Dominum.

Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: conclusion length differs: the 1962 prints "Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate."; the antecedent prints "Per Dominum. 579 Postcommunio tuos, Domine,"; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. Corroboration: 1862 at text-layer lines 61371-61381 (printed p. 432), alignment 0.73. Recorded limitation: The 1962 reading was settled on the facsimile page image; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer only and its letterforms and pointing were not verified on a page image (the 1862's images are not available to this lane, and the Mame's were not rendered for this entry). What was NOT checked: the Benziger conformed printing was used only as a boundary check on the extraction, never as a reading; no attempt was made to establish which of several possible loci in the antecedent is the 'original' one, since an order is not a contribution. This oration is one the Missal draws from a Common; the antecedent witness may print it at the Common, at another saint's day, or at both. That is a difference of position, not of words.

propers.text:

clementer intende: et propugnatores fidei sub tua protectione custodi. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Fideles tuos, Domine, custodiant sacramenta, quae sumpsimus: et,
intercedente beato Petro Martyre tuo, contra omnes adversos tueantur
incursus. Per Dominum.
